title: Remove Tip (A-Axis) Controller PCA on the Tipper Station (LOTO + side panel access)
summary: Prepare the tipper for on-site Tip (or A-Axis) Controller PCA replacement by performing LOTO and removing the station side panel (when necessary) to access the motor/controller area.
when_to_use: Use when you need to replace the Tip (or A-Axis) Controller PCA and must first isolate the tipper (LOTO) and gain access to the motor/controller area by removing the station side panel if required.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for the full LOTO steps in the referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure (page 2).
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Perform on-site LOTO for the tipper and remove the station side panel (if necessary) to access the motor/controller area for the PCA replacement work.
safety_notes: Perform LOTO for the tipper using the referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure (page 2).
Wear PPE: safety glasses and gloves.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical access to the tipper station
LOTO procedure referenced as "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" (page 2)

system_preconditions: Tip (or A-Axis) Controller PCA replacement work is required (replacement part available).
external_references: OptiSweep Operation and Maintenance Manual, "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" (page 2) referenced by this procedure.

visual_references.description: Figure 7-18: Tip PCA diagram used to identify the Tip (A-Axis) PCA referenced in the replacement procedure.
Figure 7-19: Controller PCA diagram showing the controller box/mounting context (supports understanding of the motor/controller access area after side panel removal).

steps.title: Perform LOTO for the tipper
steps.purpose: Isolate the tipper before accessing the motor/controller area for PCA replacement work.
steps.instruction: At the tipper station, perform LOTO for the tipper using the referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure (page 2).
steps.expected_result: The tipper is locked out/tagged out.
steps.healthy_condition: The tipper is in a locked out/tagged out state per the referenced LOTO procedure (page 2).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot complete LOTO for the tipper (e.g., missing/incorrect LOTO control access or inability to apply lockout/tagout).

actions.label: Apply tipper LOTO
actions.exact_action: LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot complete LOTO for the tipper.

source_evidence.evidence_text: 7.3.17.1: REMOVAL 1. LOTO the tipper (see "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" on page 2).

steps.title: Remove the station side panel (if necessary) to access the motor
steps.purpose: Provide physical access to the motor/controller area required for the Tip (A-Axis) Controller PCA replacement work.
steps.instruction: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws for the station side panel, then remove the station side panel to access the motor.
steps.expected_result: The station side panel is removed (or confirmed unnecessary) such that the motor/controller access area is reachable.
steps.healthy_condition: The nine (9) self-tapping securing screws are removed and the station side panel comes off, exposing the motor/controller access area.
steps.failure_condition: After removing the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws, the side panel cannot be removed (e.g., possible missing fasteners or incorrect panel).

actions.label: Check whether side panel removal is necessary
actions.exact_action: If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

actions.label: Remove side panel securing screws
actions.exact_action: use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel

actions.label: Remove station side panel
actions.exact_action: remove the station side panel to access the motor

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws (possible missing fasteners or incorrect panel).

source_evidence.evidence_text: 7.3.17.1: REMOVAL 2. If necessary, use a 3/8-in. wrench or socket to remove the nine (9) self-tapping securing the side panel then remove the station side panel to access the motor.

success_criteria: Station side panel is removed (or confirmed unnecessary) and the motor/controller access area is reachable for the next PCA removal step.
healthy_conditions: LOTO for the tipper is completed using the referenced "Operator Station Lockout/Tagout" procedure (page 2).
Side panel removal succeeds after removing the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws, exposing the motor/controller access area.
failure_conditions: LOTO for the tipper cannot be completed.
Side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if you cannot complete LOTO for the tipper.
Stop and escalate if the side panel cannot be removed after removing the nine (9) self-tapping securing screws (possible missing fasteners or incorrect panel).
